role: Defines the theatre every other component is scoped to.
decision: Use dubai_urban ((55.0, 25.05, 55.55, 25.34)) as the primary theatre, working in EPSG:32640 metres.
rationale: A flat coastal city: Arabian Gulf shoreline along the north-west edge, a dense ordinary urban strip parallel to it, and low inland dunes rising to the south-east. Chosen as the opposite terrain morphology to tehran_basin and owens_valley -- almost no relief, so terrain masking is weak and the radar horizon (earth curvature over a measured local refraction factor) carries most of the geometry. That makes it a test of the LOS model's curvature term rather than of ridge masking. Outside 3DEP coverage, so the DEM is Copernicus GLO-30. The threat field over this AOI is randomly spawned and parameterised exactly as it is everywhere else in the project; nothing here models any real air-defence disposition, and the guardrail in docs/DATA.md applies unchanged. The AOI was accepted only after the true line-of-sight test confirmed a monotonic masking gradient with height above ground; a flat theatre would make the signature mechanic unlearnable no matter how good the policy is.

parameters.name: dubai_urban
parameters.bounds_policy: A modest rectangular civilian urban-and-coastal test envelope, about 55 x 32 km, chosen to contain a stretch of shoreline, a dense band of ordinary urban fabric and inland dunes for height variation -- and nothing chosen for its own sake. It is not an airport, port or sensitive-site study: the south edge (25.05 N) is placed so the box stays clear of the military airfield south of the city and of most of the Jebel Ali port basin, and the civil airports and port areas it does contain are protected zones that every presentation effect is kept clear of. Bounds are fixed here and recorded in the env.aoi component; changing them changes the AOI fingerprint and invalidates every cached artifact keyed to it.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (north-east)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure. Kept clear of every presentation effect, so no fictional effect can read as happening at an airport.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (east)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure at the box's north-east corner; kept clear of every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: port and industrial waterfront (south-west corner)
protected_zones.reason: Port and industrial infrastructure along the south-west edge. Kept clear of every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: city harbour (north)
protected_zones.reason: Harbour infrastructure on the northern waterfront; kept clear of every presentation effect.

invariants: Cache keys embed the AOI bounds fingerprint; changing the box invalidates the DEM.
All env geometry is metric UTM; no per-step geodesy.

sources.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
sources.citation: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1/3 arc-second Digital Elevation Model. USGS National Map 3DEP Dynamic Service.
sources.notes: CONUS coverage only. Non-US areas of interest must fall back to Copernicus GLO-30.
